Class TaskContext

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.task.TaskContext
public final class TaskContext extends Object
Services made available to a BackgroundTask while it executes.

The context is owned by its TaskHandle and is valid for the lifetime of that handle. Its methods may be called from the task's worker thread. Progress, message, and refresh notifications are routed through the underlying simulation engine and therefore reach listeners on Swing's EDT. High-frequency progress, message, and refresh notifications retain the engine's coalescing behavior.

    • isCancellationRequested

      public boolean isCancellationRequested()
      Tests whether cancellation has been requested.
      Returns:
      true after the first call to TaskHandle.cancel()

    • throwIfCancellationRequested

      public void throwIfCancellationRequested()
      Aborts the current task cooperatively if cancellation was requested.

      The resulting exception is intercepted by MDI and reported as cancellation, not failure.

      Throws:
      TaskCancelledException - if cancellation was requested
